senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly

ex.en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
ex.zh: 她的新工作薪水更高，工时也更短。

ex.en: Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 虽然薪水会影响职业选择，但许多毕业生也重视工作保障和职业发展机会。

tip: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food
to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
ex.zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
tip: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

senses.en: Tasting of salt or containing a lot of salt.

ex.en: The soup was too salty, so I added water.
ex.zh: 汤太咸了，所以我加了些水。

ex.en: Eating salty snacks frequently can contribute to high blood pressure, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease.
ex.zh: 经常吃咸味零食可能导致高血压，增加患心血管疾病的风险。

tip: salty强调咸味；salted强调加过盐。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them.
To place or squeeze something between two other things.

ex.en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
ex.zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。

tip: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

senses.en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations.
Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.

ex.en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
ex.zh: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。

ex.en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
ex.zh: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。

tip: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

senses.zh: 令人满意的，令人满足的

senses.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

ex.en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。

ex.en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
ex.zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。

tip: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。

senses.en: To express something using words.
To give information in writing or through other evidence.
The opportunity to influence a decision.

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

ex.en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
ex.zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

col: say something to someone｜对某人说某事
have a say in｜对……有发言权
tip: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

senses.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen
to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

ex.en: My busy schedule leaves little time for cooking during weekdays.
ex.zh: 工作日里，我繁忙的日程几乎不给做饭留下时间。

ex.en: Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.
ex.zh: 大学应合理安排考试，让学生在各项考核之间有足够的复习和休息时间。

tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。

senses.en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there.
A group sharing particular ideas, methods, or styles.
A group of fish swimming together.

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
ex.zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

ex.en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

tip: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

senses.en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments
A particular field of study using scientific methods

ex.en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。

ex.en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
ex.zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。

tip: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

senses.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

senses.en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition
to gain points in a game, test, or competition
music written for a film or the written music itself

ex.en: My score improved after a week of practice.
ex.zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。

ex.en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
ex.zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。

tip: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
ex.zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。

ex.en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
ex.zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。

tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

senses.en: the large area of salt water covering much of Earth
a large mass of similar things seen together

ex.en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
ex.zh: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生生物，并可能最终影响人类的食物供应。

col: a sea of faces｜人头攒动
tip: at sea指在海上；by the sea指在海边。

senses.en: Sea animals, especially shellfish, eaten as food.

ex.en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在港口买了新鲜海鲜。

ex.en: Demand for sustainable seafood has encouraged some fishing communities to adopt methods that cause less damage to marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对可持续海产品的需求促使一些渔业社区采用对海洋生态系统破坏较小的捕捞方式。

tip: 通常是不可数名词；一盘海鲜可说a plate of seafood。

senses.en: The area beside the sea, especially where people spend holidays
Located beside the sea, especially in a holiday area

ex.en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我们下午在海边堆沙堡。

ex.en: Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.
ex.zh: 海滨小镇往往依赖夏季旅游业，这可能使当地居民的就业不稳定。

tip: 名词常用 the seaside；表示“在海边”用 at。

senses.en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions.
A period when a particular activity or event usually happens.
Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

senses.en: A place or object for someone to sit on.
To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.
A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

tip: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

senses.en: Coming immediately after the first in an order.
A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

ex.en: This is my second cup of tea today.
ex.zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。

ex.en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。

tip: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。

senses.en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education.
Less important than something else.

ex.en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 暑假过后，我妹妹就要上中学了。

ex.en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得优质中等教育的机会可以改善农村年轻人的就业前景。

tip: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

senses.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.
Information known only to a limited group of people.
An important way of achieving a particular result.

ex.en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。

ex.en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
ex.zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。

col: the secret to success｜成功的秘诀
tip: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: A distinct part of something larger.
A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something.
To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.

ex.en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
ex.zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。

ex.en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
ex.zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。

tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

senses.en: to notice something using your eyes
to understand something
to meet or visit someone

ex.en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
ex.zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。

ex.en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
ex.zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。

col: see someone's point｜理解某人的意思
tip: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

senses.en: A small part of a plant that can grow into another.
Put seeds into soil so that plants will grow.

ex.en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
ex.zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。

ex.en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
ex.zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。

col: plant a seed｜种下一粒种子
tip: sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。

senses.en: To appear to be a certain way.

ex.en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
ex.zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
ex.zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。

tip: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

senses.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We seldom eat out because we enjoy cooking together.
ex.zh: 我们很少外出吃饭，因为我们喜欢一起做饭。

ex.en: Rural communities seldom receive the same level of public transport investment as major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区很少获得与主要城市中心同等水平的公共交通投资。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；置于句首常需倒装。

senses.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.
Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.

ex.en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
ex.zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。

ex.en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
ex.zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。

col: select from a list｜从列表中选择
select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色
a select group｜精选的一群人
tip: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

senses.en: to give something to someone in exchange for money
to be bought in a particular quantity or way
to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
ex.zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

col: sell something to someone｜把某物卖给某人
sell an idea｜推销一个想法
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

senses.en: To make something go or be delivered to another place.
To arrange for someone to go somewhere.

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
ex.zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。

ex.en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

col: send someone to do something｜派某人去做某事
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。

senses.en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation.
Older than someone else, or relating to older people.
A final-year school or college student, or an older adult.

ex.en: A senior nurse showed me how to change the bandage.
ex.zh: 一位资深护士教我如何更换绷带。

ex.en: Senior managers should consult employees before introducing policies that significantly affect working conditions across the organisation.
ex.zh: 高层管理人员在推行显著影响整个机构工作条件的政策前，应征求员工意见。

col: senior to someone｜级别高于某人
tip: 比较级别用senior to，不用senior than。

senses.en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.
A feeling or awareness of something.
To become aware of something without being directly told.

ex.en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。

ex.en: Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.
ex.zh: 社区花园可以创造日常社交机会，从而增强居民的归属感。

tip: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。

senses.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command
a punishment officially given by a court
to officially give someone a punishment in court

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
ex.zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。

ex.en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。

col: sentence someone to｜判处某人……刑罚
tip: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。

senses.en: causing harm or requiring careful attention
not joking, or thinking carefully about something

ex.en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
ex.zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。

ex.en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。

col: take something seriously｜认真对待某事
tip: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

senses.en: To give food or drink, or assist customers.
To work for people, an organisation, or your country.
To be used for a particular purpose.

ex.en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。

ex.en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。

tip: serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

senses.en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers.
Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working.
A formal religious ceremony.

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

tip: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

senses.en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule.
A group of related things that belong together.
Fixed or arranged in advance.

ex.en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。

ex.en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
ex.zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。

col: a set of tools｜一套工具
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: several of them｜他们中的几个
for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement
to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something.
Used with I or we to express future intentions formally.
Used in formal rules to state a requirement.

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？

ex.en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
ex.zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

senses.en: A painful feeling caused by doing something wrong or embarrassing.
Something that causes disappointment or regret.
To make someone feel guilty or embarrassed about their behaviour.

ex.en: He felt shame after lying to his closest friend.
ex.zh: 对最亲近的朋友撒谎后，他感到羞愧。

ex.en: Schools should address bullying without creating a culture of shame that prevents pupils from seeking help.
ex.zh: 学校应处理欺凌问题，同时避免形成让学生因羞耻而不敢求助的氛围。

col: shame someone into doing something｜使某人因羞愧而做某事
tip: 羞愧义通常不可数；It's a shame表示真遗憾。

senses.en: the outer form of something
to influence how something develops
to give something a particular physical form

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

col: stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

senses.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.
One part of something divided among people or groups.
One of the equal units of ownership in a company.

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

senses.en: a farm animal kept for its wool, meat or milk

ex.en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
ex.zh: 几只绵羊正在农场附近的一棵树下休息。

ex.en: Keeping too many sheep on fragile grasslands can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 在脆弱的草地上饲养过多绵羊会破坏植被，增加水土流失的风险。

col: a flock of sheep｜一群绵羊
tip: sheep单复数同形；山羊是goat。

senses.en: A flat board used to support or store things.
A broad, relatively flat area of rock or seabed.

ex.en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
ex.zh: 把干净杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。

ex.en: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
ex.zh: 把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。

tip: 复数是shelves；shelf life指保质期。

senses.en: To give out or reflect light.
To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth.
Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

col: shine a light on｜用灯照向
tip: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

ex.en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
ex.zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。

tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

senses.en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.

ex.en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
ex.zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。

ex.en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
ex.zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。

tip: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

senses.en: A place where people buy goods or services.
To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.

ex.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
ex.zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。

tip: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

senses.en: Having little length, height, or duration.
Not having as much of something as is needed.
Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

senses.en: used to give advice or say what is right
used to say something is expected or likely
used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: should be able to｜应该能够
tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

senses.en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice.
A loud call or cry made with the voice.

ex.en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
ex.zh: 我们朝河对岸大喊，却没有人听见。

ex.en: In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的教室里，教师可能需要大声说话，长期如此会损伤嗓音。

col: shout to someone｜向某人高声说话
tip: shout at常含生气意味；shout to重在让远处的人听见。

senses.en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works.
To provide information or evidence that something is true.
A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.

ex.en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
ex.zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。

ex.en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: show someone how to｜教某人如何
tip: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

senses.en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this
A short period of rain
Wash your body under water falling from a shower

ex.en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
ex.zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
ex.zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。

tip: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。

senses.en: to close something or stop being open for business
closed or not open for business

ex.en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
ex.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前把窗户关上。

ex.en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
ex.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民便失去了宝贵的免费学习资源和共享社区空间。

col: shut down a factory｜关闭工厂
keep something shut｜让某物保持关闭
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shut；现在分词为shutting。

senses.en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people
to move away suddenly in fear, especially of a horse

ex.en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
ex.zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。

ex.en: Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 小组讨论可以帮助害羞的学生建立信心，为在全班面前发言做准备。

tip: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。

senses.en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Feeling that you might vomit.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

ex.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
ex.zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

col: call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

senses.en: An edge or surface of something, or the space beside it.
One aspect of something or one group in a disagreement.
To support one person or group in a disagreement.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。

ex.en: Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.
ex.zh: 在作出任何重大政策决定之前，公共讨论都应考虑问题的正反两面。

col: the other side of the argument｜争论的另一面
tip: side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

senses.en: The ability to see.
The act of seeing or the area that can be seen.
Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.

ex.en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
ex.zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。

ex.en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
ex.zh: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。

tip: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

senses.en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一上午在老港口一带观光。

ex.en: Sightseeing tours can support local economies, especially when visitors choose guides and businesses from the community.
ex.zh: 观光游览能促进当地经济，尤其是在游客选择当地社区的导游和商家时。

tip: 不可数名词；说go sightseeing，不加a。

senses.en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop
An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information
Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement

ex.en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
ex.zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。

ex.en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
ex.zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。

col: a sign of improvement｜好转的迹象
tip: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message.
An electrical or radio wave carrying information.
Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.

ex.en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
ex.zh: 教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。

ex.en: Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

senses.en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak.
Making no sound or containing no noise.
Written in a word but not pronounced.

ex.en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
ex.zh: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。

ex.en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。

tip: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

senses.en: Fine thread produced by silkworms, or fabric made from it.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。

ex.en: Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。

tip: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought
Playfully funny in a way that is not serious

ex.en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。

ex.en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
ex.zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。

tip: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

senses.en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.

ex.en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
ex.zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。

ex.en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
ex.zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。

tip: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.en: from a past time until a later time, usually now
from when something happened; because something is true
at a time or throughout the period after that

ex.en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
ex.zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。

ex.en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
ex.zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。

tip: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

senses.en: To make musical sounds with your voice.
For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

col: sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

senses.en: A person who sings, especially as a job.

ex.en: The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
ex.zh: 观众开始鼓掌时，歌手露出了笑容。

ex.en: Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.
ex.zh: 当地节庆为年轻歌手提供了宝贵的公开演出机会，帮助他们建立对自身能力的信心。

tip: sing 的过去式、过去分词分别是 sang、sung。

senses.en: Only one, rather than several or many.
Not married or not in a romantic relationship.
For travel to a destination without a return journey.

ex.en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
ex.zh: 停电时，房间里只有一支蜡烛照明。

ex.en: No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通和地方规划，任何单一政策都无法解决城市拥堵。

col: a single person｜一个人；单身人士
tip: 单程票英式常说single ticket，美式用one-way ticket。

senses.en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher.
A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。

ex.en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
ex.zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

col: excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生
Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

senses.en: a female sibling
a woman who belongs to a religious community

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

senses.en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom
to be in a particular place or position
to take an examination

ex.en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
ex.zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。

ex.en: Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
ex.zh: 长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

senses.en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.

ex.en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
ex.zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。

col: deal with a situation｜应对某种情况
tip: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.
To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

tip: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

senses.en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes
a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly

ex.en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。

ex.en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
ex.zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。

col: a pair of skates｜一双溜冰鞋
tip: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

col: develop a skill｜培养一项技能
skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。

ex.en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
ex.zh: 保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。

tip: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

senses.en: Clothing hanging from the waist, without separate sections for legs.
To move around the edge of something.
To avoid dealing directly with a difficult subject.

ex.en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
ex.zh: 她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。

ex.en: Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。

col: skirt the edge of｜沿……边缘行进
tip: skirt是裙子；dress通常指连衣裙。

senses.en: The space above the earth where clouds and stars appear.

ex.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
ex.zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。

tip: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

senses.en: to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced
the natural resting state in which awareness is reduced

ex.en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
ex.zh: 我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。

ex.en: Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
ex.zh: 规律的睡眠有助于记忆和注意力，因此对备考学生尤其重要。

col: get enough sleep｜获得充足睡眠
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为slept；入睡用fall asleep。

senses.en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

ex.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

col: slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

senses.en: At a low speed or over a long time.

ex.en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
ex.zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。

ex.en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 尽管公众观念改变得较慢，但越来越多的消费者正在选择塑料包装更少的产品。

col: slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地
tip: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。

senses.en: Limited in size, amount, or degree.
Young and not yet fully grown.
Not very important or serious.

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

senses.en: intelligent or showing good judgment
neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion
using computer technology to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
ex.zh: 用那个办法修好架子真聪明。

ex.en: Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
ex.zh: 智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。

tip: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

senses.en: a quality sensed through the nose, or that sensing ability
notice or examine something using your nose
have or give off a particular scent

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread filled our kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在我们的厨房里。

ex.en: A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
ex.zh: 嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。

tip: smell作系动词后接形容词，如smell good。

senses.en: To raise the corners of your mouth, showing happiness or friendliness.
A facial expression with raised mouth corners, often showing happiness.

ex.en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
ex.zh: 我在房间另一头挥手时，宝宝笑了。

ex.en: A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
ex.zh: 友善的微笑能让患者在与医护人员讨论自己的顾虑时感到更自在。

tip: 对某人微笑用smile at，不用smile to。

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

ex.en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。

ex.en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
ex.zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。

tip: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。

col: snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。
